channel.title: Farsçadan (English)
channel.description: AI-assisted English translations of selected stories from Iran's Persian-language press. Every story notes the outlet's political orientation.

item.title: Larijani: 'Nuclear weapons can be used tactically against enemy military base'
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Larijani said nuclear weapons shouldn't target civilians but can be used tactically against enemy military bases. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.title: Two tankers caught fire in Hormuz: Iran said mine, U.S. claimed strike on blockade-breaking ship
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Two tankers exploded and caught fire in Strait of Hormuz; Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed a mine, U.S. said it struck a blockade-busting vessel. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: CENTCOM extends Iran blockade to land borders: 'Iron Gate' established
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Iran International, CENTCOM established 'Iron Gate' to block shipments of weapons and sanctioned goods to Iran via land borders and Caspian Sea. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Eisenkot, Netanyahu's rival, tasked with forming government in Israel
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Herzog tasked Netanyahu's fiercest rival, Gadi Eisenkot, with forming a new government; 67 Knesset members had nominated him. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Erdoğan-Trump phone call: U.S.-Iran tension should be resolved through diplomacy
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Khabaronline, Erdoğan told Trump in a phone call that U.S.-Iran tension must be resolved through diplomacy; the call also covered Ukraine. (Source: Khabaronline (Anadolu Agency))

item.title: Times claim of iodine tablets near nuclear facilities rejected by Health Ministry
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Iran's Health Ministry spokesman denied The Times's claim that iodine tablets were distributed near nuclear sites; no ministry official granted interview. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.title: Telegraph: Iran requested S-400 air defense from Putin during Rezai's Moscow visit
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Telegraph, Iran requested S-400 air defenses from Putin during Rezai's Moscow visit; leaked documents show Russian missile production for Iran. (Source: Ettelaat (via Telegraph))

item.title: U.S. Treasury sanctions eight Canada-based money exchangers serving Iran's regime
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned eight Canada-based money transfer firms serving Iran's regime under the Operation Economic Outcast campaign. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Al-Monitor: Erdoğan's Baku visit cannot mask Turkey-Azerbaijan tensions
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Al-Monitor reports that Erdoğan's visit to Baku for November 8 Victory Day may not overcome deeper Turkey-Azerbaijan tensions rooted in headscarf crisis. (Source: Khabaronline (via Al-Monitor))

item.title: New tension on Qeshm Island: military claims U.S. MQ-9 downed, CENTCOM silent
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Iran's military announced it downed a U.S. MQ-9 drone over Qeshm Island; reports of explosions and fighter jets merged, CENTCOM declined to comment. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Shooting spree in Afyonkarahisar: eight killed across three villages
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Armed attacks across three villages in western Turkey's Afyonkarahisar province left eight dead; suspect arrested in Eskişehir. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Axios: Trump to decide on new Iran strike soon
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Per Axios, Trump will soon choose between a new strike on Iran, continued economic pressure, or a diplomatic deal; Qatar offers to open Hormuz. (Source: Hamshahri (via Axios))

item.title: Rezaei's undisclosed Moscow visit: Supreme Leader's message to Putin
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Supreme National Security Council Secretary Rezaei met Putin in undisclosed Moscow visit, delivering Supreme Leader Khamenei's message. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Brent crude rebounds from post-election dip, crosses $100 per barrel again
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Per Reuters via IRNA, Brent crude futures on Friday surged more than $2 per barrel to cross $100. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Europe: at least 14 flights targeted with bomb threats, fighter jets launched
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: At least 14 European flights operated by Aer Lingus, Wizz Air, Finnair, Ryanair and LOT faced bomb threats; fighter jets escorted some aircraft. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Turkish soldier killed at Iran border; fire assessed to have come from Iranian side
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Turkish soldier killed at border in gunfire from Iranian side during illegal crossing response; both countries launched investigations. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: U.S. sanctions Istanbul-based Fugo, which provides ground services to blacklisted Iranian airlines
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: The U.S. Treasury Department added Istanbul-based Fugo Ground Services to its sanctions list for providing ground services to blacklisted Iranian airlines. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: FT: Russia agrees to supply Iran with 90 helicopter-mounted rocket launcher systems
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: The Financial Times reported that Russia agreed to supply Iran with 90 guided rocket launchers mountable on Mi-28 helicopters; delivery has not been confirmed. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Oman and Iran seek technical arrangements for resuming maritime traffic in Hormuz
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Oman's Foreign Ministry said technical discussions are underway with Tehran for safe resumption of marine traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.title: Iran courts recover 10.5 billion euros in foreign currency from economic crime prosecutions
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: The head of Tehran's judiciary announced that 10.5 billion euros in foreign currency have been recovered to the country from economic crime prosecutions. (Source: Donya-e Eqtesad (via ISNA))
